gaps.reason: SEM_V1 cannot enforce the source blood-specimen requirement on Plasmodium-specific microscopy (OID 2.16.840.1.113762.1.4.1146.2248) or generic microscopy (OIDs 2.16.840.1.113762.1.4.1146.900 and 2.16.840.1.113762.1.4.1146.1040); MAL-R2 retains the specimen-specific test-name branches (OIDs 2.16.840.1.113762.1.4.1146.466 and 2.16.840.1.113762.1.4.1146.884)

SEM_V1 has no same-observation numeric comparison predicate for the source lab-result-value-greater-than-zero alternative; MAL-R2 retains the coded positive, organism, and abnormal-interpretation alternatives
